title: Delhi Traffic Police named accident-prone zones 2013 to 2015 and early road stretches 2011 to 2012, as printed
scope: Named selected accident-prone zones (one row per zone) and, for 2011 and 2012, printed highway and ring-road stretch statistics. Counts within selected zones or stretches, not whole-city or whole-road counts. Counts, not rates.

sources.note: Delhi PWD compilation of the Traffic Police accident-prone locations (archived PDF, pages 133-141). An official compilation, not a recovered annual report.
Delhi Traffic Police Road Accidents in Delhi 2015, chapter 10 (Table 10.1).
Road Accidents in Delhi 2015, Table 6.5 (printed page 42, PDF page 5): a retrospective table of highway and ring-road stretches that includes 2011 and 2012.

derivedTotals.note: Sums of the printed rows. 2013 and 2014 print no grand total in the compilation; 2015 does not reconcile to a printed total either, apart from the cross-checks below.

blankRoads.note: Serials whose road cell is blank in the source; the road stays null.

roads2015.derivation: Calculated by exact printed road label from Table 10.1. Not a printed road-summary table; printed spelling variants of one road remain separate groups, so this is not necessarily 45 unique roads.

roads2011to2012.note: Six national highways, four Ring Road stretches and three Outer Ring Road stretches per year. Simple is separate from non-injury in this source; fatal + simple + non-injury = total. Not selected-zone sums. Original annual reports and zone tables for 2011 and 2012 were not located.

supersession: 2014 named zones come only from the PWD compilation (137 rows with counts). An older name-only 2014 list (137 names, null counts, different serial order and spellings) exists in the recovery package and is not used; serial numbers are never joined across the two.
caveats: Each year selects its own zones and the list changes every year; a longer list or a larger sum is not a worse year.
The 2013 and 2014 compilation gives printed district and circle names; 2014 uses circle codes with no district assignment. They are kept as printed and are not mapped to any later district.
No coordinates; a repeated name does not prove an unchanged location.
Selected-page visual review was done for 2013 and 2014; no independent second transcription review is claimed. 2015 was visually transcribed by the extracting agent and not independently reviewed.
Archive timestamps and upload folders are not publication dates.
